body:
Stage, podium and judges' table kept exactly as Non-living laid them out, on one smooth sand oval.
Tree at -37.4,16.2 moved to -39.2,13.4 (room for the podium).
Playground slide moved 1.8 m west and 2 m back (it was cramped behind the judges).
Game code for the update: slide group (-37.2,31.5) -> (-39.0,33.5); col box -> (-39.7,30.4,-38.3,35.8); slide spot -> (-39.0,30.1); startSlide path x -37.2 -> -39.0, z +2.
Checked in pictures: no overlaps; food truck close to the podium but not touching.

comments.text: Approved: you decided it in chat (31 Oct): check it and keep the three elements as they are.
